Products by Business Unit and Market
Cloud Memory Business Unit ("CMBU")

: CMBU sales to the data center end market are driven by server demand across the cloud market and include our portfolio of HBM, high-capacity dual in-line memory modules ("DIMMs"), and low-power server DRAM solutions
Core Data Center Business Unit ("CDBU")
Data Center SSDs and NAND
: CDBU sales to OEM data center customers are driven by server and storage demand to support enterprise and NeoCloud customers, and our sales consisted primarily of DDR5 and DDR4
Mobile and Client Business Unit ("MCBU")

Mobile: Consists of memory products sold into the smartphone and other mobile-device markets, specifically LPDDR. MCBU offers a portfolio of LPDDR solutions designed for next-generation smartphones to accelerate AI applications in the mobile market
